rows.grounds: adverb indicating special emphasis or preference
naturally perfected or self-manifest, not artificially prepared; compound svayam+siddha
a stone object serving as a support or material
sandhi fusion ratnam+eva within the token; emphasizes a gem as an alternative

items.question: Which naturally accomplished materials hold special suitability as consecrated supports?
premises: Previously mentioned supports include mantra-consecrated cloth, wall-paintings, or pedestals.
Special preference is given to materials that are self-accomplished.
Such self-accomplished materials include stone or even a gem.
items.inference: Among possible supports, a self-accomplished stone or gem is especially suitable.
uncertainties: The exact ritual function of these materials depends on the preceding syntactic context.
items.plain_english: Especially suitable is a self-accomplished stone, or indeed a gem.
